name: AmiCradle-runtime-arm64-stream3d
notes: AmiCradle runtime for Pi 5, CM5 and CM4 cards, Stream3D RC1: the whole tuned set (a76, a72 and portable) with one build stamp; the installer checks every SHA-256 and clears stale tuned files. GLQuake timedemo 640x480 on a CM4: 20.6 fps (same speed as RC3).
